title: VBench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models
claim: Defines 16 evaluation dimensions with tailored prompts and human alignment checks.
limitations: Original benchmark distribution; not a professional production acceptance policy.

title: VBench++: Comprehensive and Versatile Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models
claim: Extends the VBench approach to image-to-video and trustworthiness evaluation.
limitations: Distinct version and protocol; results must not be silently merged with VBench.

title: VBench-2.0: Advancing Video Generation Benchmark Suite for Intrinsic Faithfulness
claim: Evaluates human fidelity, controllability, creativity, physics, and commonsense.
limitations: Source-reported human alignment is not universal causal or physics validity.

title: VBench-2.0 official implementation
claim: Documents benchmark prompt lists, evaluation pipeline, and custom-video support.
limitations: Live branch not pinned or executed; dependencies and model licenses require later qualification.

title: EvalCrafter: Benchmarking and Evaluating Large Video Generation Models
claim: Uses 700 prompts, 17 objective metrics, and fitted human-alignment coefficients.
limitations: Fitted weights need validation for new audiences and model distributions.

title: T2V-CompBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Compositional Text-to-video Generation
claim: Measures seven compositional categories with MLLM, detection, and tracking methods.
limitations: Category-dependent instruments; not proof of exhaustive temporal or causal validity.

title: VideoScore: Building Automatic Metrics to Simulate Fine-grained Human Feedback for Video Generation
claim: Trains automatic multi-aspect assessment from VideoFeedback containing 37.6K synthesized videos.
limitations: Reported correlations are dataset-specific; contemporary generator shift requires revalidation.

title: VideoScore-v1.1 model card
claim: Provides a published VideoScore model as a candidate baseline for learned assessment.
limitations: Weights not downloaded; capability claims not tested locally.

title: On the Content Bias in Frechet Video Distance
claim: Reports content bias that can favor spatial quality over temporal consistency in FVD.
limitations: Does not imply FVD is useless for all matched distribution-level comparisons.

title: Evaluating Text-to-Visual Generation with Image-to-Text Generation
claim: Proposes VQAScore and diagnoses compositional weaknesses of CLIP-like alignment.
limitations: A VQA score is model-dependent, not a calibrated probability of overall correctness.

title: GenEval: An Object-Focused Framework for Evaluating Text-to-Image Alignment
claim: Introduces object-focused text-to-image alignment evaluation.
limitations: Older benchmark may drift as models change; do not treat detector outputs as ground truth.

title: GenAI-Bench: Evaluating and Improving Compositional Text-to-Visual Generation
claim: Studies compositional text-to-visual generation and alignment against human ratings.
limitations: Disambiguate from the separately authored TIGER-Lab GenAI-Bench dataset.

title: TIGER-Lab GenAI-Bench dataset card
claim: Documents pairwise human-preference data for image, image-editing, and video evaluation.
limitations: Shared benchmark name does not imply identical authors, prompts, or labels.

title: GenEval 2: Addressing Benchmark Drift in Text-to-Image Evaluation
claim: Documents benchmark drift and proposes more compositional evaluation with Soft-TIFA.
limitations: Continual audits remain necessary; no guarantee the replacement cannot drift.

title: DynamicEval: Rethinking Evaluation for Dynamic Text-to-Video Synthesis
claim: Studies dynamic camera motion and foreground/background consistency including occlusion failures.
limitations: ArXiv page labels it a preprint under review; local reproduction not performed.

title: T2VPhysBench: A First-Principles Benchmark for Physical Consistency in Text-to-Video Generation
claim: Uses physical-law testing, human evaluation, hint ablations, and counterfactual prompts.
limitations: Physics criteria require declared world assumptions and sufficient visual evidence.

title: PhyWorldBench: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Physical Realism in Text-to-Video Models
claim: Includes multiple physical phenomena and an Anti-Physics category.
limitations: Abstract model total/group counts are inconsistent; no exact model-count claim adopted.

title: RAVEN-Eval: Rubric-Guided Automatic Evaluation for AI Video Generation Models Based on LMM Preference Judgement
claim: Uses task-specific pairwise rubrics and anchor-based model insertion; acknowledges sparse-frame motion limitations.
limitations: Incomplete human coverage and limited model set restrict scalability evidence; no universal approval guarantee.

title: VGA-BenchV2: An Expanded Unified Benchmark and Multi-Model Framework for Evaluating Video Aesthetics and Generation Quality
claim: Separates aesthetic and generation quality in a 52-subdimension taxonomy with specialized evaluators.
limitations: Author-reported alignment; taxonomy needs local rater-discriminability testing.

title: VGI-Bench: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
claim: Evaluates visual reasoning capabilities through generated outputs.
limitations: Not a measure of all-purpose intelligence or general real-world reliability.

title: Knowledge-Intensive Video Generation
claim: Introduces factuality and helpfulness evaluation for explanatory or procedural video; revised September 28, 2026.
limitations: Domain correctness still needs qualified evidence; automatic metrics not locally validated.

title: VTR-Bench: A Systematic Benchmark for Evaluating Visual Text Rendering in Video Generation
claim: Evaluates video text fidelity separately from scene/motion requirements and describes an agentic keyframe workflow.
limitations: Very recent work; no independent replication established in this research pass.

title: VABench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Audio-Video Generation
claim: Provides multidimensional synchronous audio-video evaluation including audio-video and lip-speech consistency.
limitations: Audio evaluation requires observed audio and a qualified modality-specific instrument.

title: VABench CVPR 2026 proceedings
claim: Confirms the VABench work appears in CVPR 2026 proceedings.
limitations: Publication status is distinct from independent replication.

title: Veo 3.1 official model page
claim: Documents Veo3.1 capabilities; comparative charts state October2025.
limitations: Vendor comparisons are not an October2026 independent ranking or account-access proof.

title: Gemini API release notes
claim: Records Omni1.1 Flash GA August27, Gemini3.8 Flash GA September2, and Nano Banana2.1 GA October6, 2026.
limitations: Current doc snapshot; regional/account access untested; future shutdown dates are announcements.

title: Creating with Gen-4.5
claim: Documents current Gen4.5 product workflow and text/image-to-video usage.
limitations: Does not establish account API entitlement, release date, or independent quality ranking.

title: Seedance 2.0 Official Launch
claim: Announces multimodal audio-video creation supporting text, image, audio, and video input.
limitations: Announcement and capability description do not prove universal API/region availability.

title: Introducing Kling 4.0
claim: Describes early access, planned wider October rollout, and separately coming-soon features.
limitations: Do not label early access as general availability or future HDR/extension as delivered.

title: Alibaba Cloud Wan text-to-video API guide
claim: Documents wan3.0-video and migration from wan2.7.
limitations: No API called; endpoint documentation is not proof of weights release or account access.

title: Wan2.2 official repository
claim: Documents open Wan2.2 models and inference workflows.
limitations: Distinct from Wan3.0; exact checkpoint/runtime/license require recording before execution.

title: Wan3.0 official repository
claim: Provides Wan3.0 announcement and capability information.
limitations: Repository existence alone does not establish released code or model weights.

title: LTX-2 official inference repository
claim: Recommends LTX2.5 and documents component weights and inference pipelines.
limitations: Live repository not pinned/executed; pipeline versions and dependencies can change.

title: LTX-2.5 model card
claim: Documents published component weights, gated access, and community-license conditions.
limitations: Open weights do not imply unrestricted license; local hardware and runtime untested.

title: LTX-2.5 API model documentation
claim: Documents fast/pro API variants and supported generation endpoints.
limitations: API constraints differ from local pipeline behavior; no paid requests made.

title: OpenAI API deprecations
claim: Lists Sora2 aliases/snapshots and Videos API shutdown on September24, 2026.
limitations: Use for historical-provider status; does not validate availability of archived media.

title: OpenAI image generation API reference
claim: Lists GPT Image2.5 Sunburst/Flare and dated September8, 2026 snapshots.
limitations: Snapshot date is not necessarily public release date; account access untested.

title: What is FLUX.2?
claim: Describes FLUX2 variants and API versus local deployment options; page updated June12, 2026.
limitations: Variant-specific capabilities and licenses must be checked individually.

title: FLUX.2 official inference repository
claim: Provides official code and links for FLUX2 inference.
limitations: No weights or runtime executed; pin revision before reproducibility claims.

title: Gemini 3.8 Flash model documentation
claim: Documents text/image/video/audio/PDF input and structured outputs.
limitations: Input modality support is not validated temporal-judging quality.

title: Qwen3.8-27B model card
claim: Documents open native vision-language weights and image/video understanding.
limitations: No local inference; runtime, quantization, preprocessing, and licenses need recording.

title: Qwen3.8 official repository and release history
claim: Dates Qwen3.8-27B availability to August14, 2026.
limitations: The prior Qwen3.5 URL redirects here; historical versions need pinned revisions.

title: GPT-6 Astra model documentation
claim: Documents image input and structured outputs; native audio and video are not supported.
limitations: Sampled-frame analysis must not be represented as full-video observation.

title: Claude models overview
claim: Lists Fable5.1, Opus5.5, Sonnet5.5 and their text/image input support.
limitations: Catalog presence is not a media-judge qualification result or native-video guarantee.
